req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies pagination functionality using 'skip' and 'limit' parameters. Tests are designed to verify correct pagination behavior, including boundary conditions and invalid inputs.

tests.name: test_pagination_positive_case
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=5 and limit=5.
expected: Payload contains exactly 5 tasks starting from the 6th task.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?skip=5&limit=5')
assert response.status_code == 200
result = response.json()
assert len(result) == 5
assert result[0]['id'] == 6
assert result[4]['id'] == 10

tests.name: test_pagination_negative_case_invalid_skip
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=-1 and limit=5.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?skip=-1&limit=5')
assert response.status_code == 422
assert 'value_error.number.not_ge' in response.text

tests.name: test_pagination_boundary_case_limit
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=0 and limit=1000.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?skip=0&limit=1000')
assert response.status_code == 200
result = response.json()
assert len(result) == 20
assert result[0]['id'] == 1
assert result[19]['id'] == 20
